minimal_reproduction: A reviewer reopens the source and passes draft A.
The operator changes the predicate or excerpt to draft B.
The protocol contains no immutable identity binding that prevents draft B from inheriting draft A's pass.
shared_major_finding.authority_risk: The executor can also write a reviewed conclusion without leaving evidence that the reviewer was independent.
bounded_closure_without_receipt_dsl: Freeze each page draft as an exact Git commit, tree, path and blob or SHA-256 identity.
Use one plain human-readable review note bound to the record ID and exact draft identity.
Record reviewer or thread identity and an explicit declaration that the reviewer did not participate in writing the draft.
Bind the fixture identity, page state, predicate, excerpt and hash conclusions plus PASS or FAIL.
Any FAIL or contradictory review leaves that page with no observation and authority NONE; there is no latest-wins or PASS-wins rule.
Resolution requires a new immutable draft and a fresh independent review while preserving prior history.

passed_bounded_checks: The route is a real simplification with no machine validator, negative DSL, self-manifest, model pass, count, rank, score or aggregation.
The exact five-page fixture, source URLs, lanes, roles, anchors, hashes and nine predicate identifiers are recoverable.
Other participants, quotes, vendor or promotional material and inferred profile context have zero propagation.
Missing, duplicate, partial, ambiguous, drifted or unavailable pages do not produce observations.
Time cost, current money cost, volume, buyer intent and seller-price language remain distinct.
No cross-page repeated-signal, demand, buyer, willingness-to-pay, product or transaction conclusion is permitted.
NO_INFORMATION returns to D020 and does not reactivate model qualification.
